xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30 2026 of SOLAR INDUSTRIES INDIA LIMITED the Company have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meeting held on November 03 2026. The Company confirms that its statutory auditors have carried out limited review of the aforesaid results for the quarter and half year ended September 30 2026.
These results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standard referred to as Ind AS prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with Companies Indian Accounting Standards) Rules 2015 as amended from time to time. The Company has identified Explosives its accessories and related services as its only reportable segment as defined under Ind AS 108 Operating Segments. Accordingly no separate segment information has been provided. During the half year ended September 30 2026 the Company has partially redeemed 584 unsecured rated listed senior redeemable non convertible debentures NCDs having face value of Rs 100000 each amounting to Rs 5.83 crore and made an Interest payment amounting to Rs. 0.36 crore at a coupon rate of seven point zero six per annum.
As on September 30 2026 the aggregate amount of outstanding amount of NCD is Rs. 5.83 crore. During the quarter and half year ended September 30 2026 the Company has fully repaid Commercial Paper amounting to Rs. 75.00 crore which was issued in favour of Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited. Formulae for the computation of ratios are given in Annexure A.
As per Regulation 46 of the SEBI Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 Results are available on Companys website www.solargroup.com.
